# AWF efforts

When work needs continuity across stages, sessions, or handoffs, when an implementation worktree, intent, specification, plan, or ADR becomes relevant, or before completing or integrating implementation work, run the repository's AWF command with `docs effort`, read the guide, and follow it for the task. Reuse the guide during the task; do not load it at every session start or before every action.
